messages:
sophia: Heads up — legal flagged a new model (veridian-7b-v2) with some nonstandard clauses that might block hosted offerings. Can we do a quick intake + plan a quant bakeoff?

diego: ack. link to model card: https://huggingface.co/veridian/veridian-7b-v2 — looks like NC + share-alike-ish language in parts.

anne: quick summary from legal-bot: 'No commercial hosting, redistribution restricted, attribution required.' :warning: We need a clear gating decision before any hosted rollout.

legal-bot: automated-lic-check: license=CC-BY-NC-SA-like; export_control=none_detected; derivative_restrictions=present. Recommendation: treat as non-hostable for public API until legal review/waiver.

ravi: For Dedicated and Private we can probably support since customers manage access, but we need checklist + evals. I can run quant experiments tonight (A100 fleet).

sophia: Proposed immediate actions:
- Block model from Hosted catalog (temporary)
- Add to intake tracker with priority=medium-high (customer interest)
- Run quantization bakeoff (fp16 baseline, int8, nf4/int8-kv) on our inference stack
- Run core eval suite (latency, perplexity, hallucination rate) + embeddings drift
- Legal to confirm if partner pilot addendum is possible

diego: Draft checklist (short):
1) Confirm full license text and any human-readable constraints (LEGAL)
2) Confirm export & sanctions (SECURITY)
3) Smoke-run model load & forward pass (INFRA)
4) Run quant configs: fp16, int8 (q4_0/q8_0), int8+kv cache (ENG-RUNTIME)
5) Run prompt suite: 200-sample core + 50 hallucination probes (EVALS)
6) Compute regression metrics and pass/fail thresholds (ML)
7) Document allowed deployment modes and operator notes (DOCS)

ravi: command I'll run tonight (simple repro):
```bash
python run_infer.py --model veridian-7b-v2 --quant int8 --batch 4 --seq-len 1024 --profile
```
I'll collect latency + logits for comparison.

anne: @legal-bot — if we want to do partner pilots, can legal outline a minimal addendum? Sales may want short-term pilots for two partners. Also note attribution clause — product needs a copy for UI.

legal-bot: Partner pilot addendum path: possible with MSA + signed addendum restricting redistribution and public hosting. Requires CSM & Sales PRF + 2-week review. Attribution must be present in TOS or UI — specify exact wording.

diego: I'll mark Hosted=blocked, Dedicated=allowed-with-ops-guardrails, Private=allowed. Adding a note: "no caching of model artifacts on public storage; strict access logs."

sophia: Also add evaluation pass criteria:
- Perplexity delta vs baseline < 1.5x
- Hallucination F1 drop < 3pts on QA set
- Embedding cosine drift < 0.05 on our anchor set
- Tail latency p99 within 1.5x baseline at target batch sizes
If any fail, recommend only Private/Dedicated and document user-facing warnings.

diego: perfect. I'll create intake tracker entry and tag folks. ravi — ping when results are up, we'll triage at tomorrow 2pm sync. :thumbsup:

ravi: will do — starting runs in ~30m. planning to post a short summary + raw logs in this thread when done.

anne: great, thanks team. keeping Hosted blocked until legal signs off.

sophia: thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround.
